meta.title: Custom neon signs, made in the UK — design yours | Lit Neon
meta.description: Type your words, pick the lettering and colour, see it lit on a real-looking wall at true size and get an honest price as you go. Custom LED neon signs made in a UK workshop, proof drawing first, free mainland-GB delivery.
meta.ogTitle: Design your custom neon sign | Lit Neon
meta.ogDescription: Your words, lit. Design a custom LED neon sign in minutes and see it on the wall at true size. Made in a UK workshop.

lede: Type it, see it on the wall, know the price. Nothing is made until you approve the drawing.

scenes.title: Where will it hang?

words.label: What should it say?

words.linesFull: Three lines is the most one sign can carry.

words.pasteKept: We kept “{kept}” — the rest wouldn’t fit one sign.

lettering.label: Pick a face
lettering.help: Each name is set in its own lettering. Pick one and your words change on the wall.
lettering.thinNote: {face} needs letters at least {min} cm tall, so {size} is off for this face.

colour.label: Tube colour
colour.help: Screens vary a little. Warm white is the colour most people choose.
colour.rgbJacket: Colour-changing tubes have a white jacket
colour.rgbNote: Colour changing adds {pct} to the sign. The remote picks the colour and the effects.
colour.perLineHelp: Pick a colour for each line. Each extra colour adds {delta}.
colour.perLineOff: Switch on “Colour each line” to give a line its own colour.
colour.perLineNeedsLines: Add a second line in Your words to colour the lines separately.
colour.perLineRgb: Colour changing is one colour across the whole sign.

size.label: How big?
size.help: Sizes go by the height of a capital letter. The width follows your words.
size.tubeHelp: Standard tube suits most signs. The bold tube reads from further away and costs a little more.
size.customHint: Slide to the width you want. The letters scale with it.

backing.label: Acrylic backing
backing.help: The sign is mounted on clear or coloured acrylic. Every option is drawn on the wall as you pick it.
backing.cutSub: Acrylic follows the outline of your letters
backing.rectSub: A clean panel on brass standoffs

fitting.outdoorNote: Outdoor signs get a sealed supply and a weatherproof jacket, so a designer prices them by hand within {hours} hours. Your indoor price stays on screen as a guide.
fitting.chainsSub: From hooks or a picture rail
fitting.standNote: A table stand sits on its base, so there is nothing to hang.

review.label: Check it over
review.help: This is what we make. Read the words once more before you add it.
review.spelling: I’ve checked the spelling and capitals. Custom signs are made to these exact words.
review.spellingNeeded: Tick the box once you’ve checked the words.
review.ccr: Made to your words, so it can’t be returned for a change of mind once production starts. Faults are always put right. Your statutory rights are not affected.

learn.priceLede: Four things move it. Everything else — the dimmer, the remote, the UK plug, delivery — is included.
priceCardLines: Letter height sets the size. “{words}” is {small} at Small and {large} at Large.
More letters mean more tube to bend. “{short}” is {shortPrice}; “{long}” is {longPrice} at the same size.
One colour is included. A second colour adds {delta}; colour changing adds {rgbPct} and comes with effects on the remote.
Cut-to-shape and rectangle clear acrylic are included. A table stand adds {stand}; a mirror finish adds {mirror}.
learn.sizeLede: The preview is to scale, so trust your eyes. As a rule of thumb:
sizeLines: Above a double bed or a sofa, {bed} reads well.
On a shelf, a desk or a bar back, go {shelf}.
For a feature wall or a venue, {wall} and up.
learn.jacketLede: The jacket is the silicone sleeve around the LEDs. It decides what the sign looks like by day, switched off.
learn.jacketWhite: White jacket: white tube by day, your colour at night. The default, and the quieter choice.
learn.jacketColoured: Coloured jacket: a tinted tube by day, so the sign reads as its colour even when it’s off.
learn.compareLede: What you get from a UK workshop, next to what imported signs typically offer.
compareRows: {lead} working days after you approve the drawing
Two to four weeks, plus shipping
